journey.title: Path to IT
journey.subtitle: My journey in IT started by accident - but it became my main path. I've worked as a freelancer, remotely in a web studio, and as an office-based Bitrix developer before transitioning to frontend. Currently, I work with React and modern frontend technologies. My knowledge is built on self-study, online courses, and hands-on experience. I strongly believe that passion and curiosity matter more than a formal degree.
